en.circuitFailed: The circuit designer failed to load: {error}
en.circuitNoPins: This project declares no pins, so the board starts empty. Declare them in the Code tab — for example: {example} — and the designer will suggest matching parts.
en.stepHint: Run to the next block boundary
en.unsupportedStep: This target cannot step one block
en.noPinsToDebug: Declare pins in the Code tab to debug this project.
en.noPausePoints: Right-click a block and choose “Pause here”.
en.skippedHits: hits passed over — a wait is re-entered constantly, and conditions filter the rest
en.unreachableWhy: The program only stops at a wait or a loop, so these marks have nowhere to land in this build. They are kept in case a later edit gives them one.
en.yieldNote: The program can only stop at a wait or a loop — the highlight marks the last one it passed, not every block in between.
en.noVariables: This project has no variables yet.
en.scrubHint: Drag to look back through recorded stops. The program is not rewound — this is what was recorded then.
en.activeLow: active low: the pin drives 0 to turn it on
en.runForValues: Run the program to see values here.
en.tenInstructions: Ten instructions, each one a row in the trace
en.traceEmpty: Nothing has run yet. Press Run, then pause or hit a pause point.
en.traceGap: A row is recorded whenever the program stops. Stepping records each instruction; a free run records only where it stopped. Recording every instruction at full speed is not possible.
en.memorySpaceNote: SFR and internal RAM share these addresses and are different memories.
en.editByte: Click a byte to edit it.
en.stepOverHint: Run until SP returns to its current depth
en.codeIntro: Write your project as Pseudocode, Python, or JavaScript. You can convert between all three. “To blocks” compiles the active tab; “From blocks” reads the current project into every language. Switching tabs converts between them. Sprite and pen behavior lives in the blocks, so the code tabs show the algorithmic parts and keep comments.
en.uploadArtTitle: Upload SVGs and add them as sprite costumes
en.uploadArtHelp: Upload one or more .svg files, then choose a sprite for each in the table below. When you choose “To blocks”, each SVG is added as that sprite’s costume. “Replace” swaps its costume; “add as frame” adds an animation frame.
en.noSpriteDeclarations: No SPRITE declarations found in your pseudocode yet. Add one, for example:
en.readBlocks: Read the current blocks into all supported languages
en.driverHint: Hardware extension driver: shim (neutral), remote (WebSocket bridge), or on-brick (device transpiler). The program works with any driver; this setting only chooses the driver.
en.asyncHint: Wait for hardware calls (BLE is asynchronous) and make functions async
en.eventsHint: Turn extension event blocks (such as “when button pressed”) into driver callbacks
en.commentsHint: Show block comments as # or // lines in generated code. They are restored when converted back to blocks.
en.cHelp: C for STC12 / 8051. Paste firmware and choose “To blocks”, or compile it to a .hex file with stc-compiler.vercel.app.
en.cannotCompileLanguage: This language cannot be compiled back to blocks.
en.compiledLoaded: Compiled to blocks and loaded. Switch to the Code tab to see them.
en.readUnsupported: Read into all languages. {count} block(s) cannot be represented in pseudocode and were kept as comments.
en.readAllLanguages: Read the current project into all languages. Edit any of them, then choose “To blocks”.
en.runForeverHint: This project has a forever loop, so run it from the blocks by pressing the green flag. For a text run, try an algorithm example such as a quiz, operators, or 2048.
en.runTimedOut: ⏱ Stopped after {seconds}s — the program is still running, possibly in an infinite loop.

ja.codeIntro: 疑似コード、Python、JavaScriptでプログラムを書けます。3つの形式は相互に変換できます。「ブロックへ」で選択中のコードをブロックに変換し、「ブロックから」で現在のプロジェクトを各言語のコードとして読み込みます。タブを切り替えると、コードも変換されます。スプライトやペンの動作はブロック側で管理されるため、コードタブには主に処理の流れが表示され、コメントも保持されます。
ja.uploadArtTitle: SVG画像をアップロードしてスプライトのコスチュームに追加します
ja.uploadArtHelp: SVGファイルをアップロードし、下の表でそれぞれのスプライトを選んでください。「ブロックへ」を押すと、SVG画像がそのスプライトのコスチュームになります。「置き換え」は現在のコスチュームを入れ替え、「アニメーションに追加」はコスチュームを追加します。
